tools.name: check_availability
tools.description:
Query available appointment slots on the calendar.

CRITICAL: This tool always returns HTTP 200. A 200 does NOT mean success — read the body and act on its contents.

On SUCCESS: {"ok": true, "slots": [{"day": "YYYY-MM-DD", "time": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS", "iso": "..."}]}
- "time" = LOCAL time (Europe/London), bare, no Z, e.g. "2026-08-21T14:00:00". Pass this to book_calendar.
- "iso" = UTC reference only. NEVER book with it or copy it into a slot variable — it is 1 hour off local.
- Only offer/book slots literally present in the slots list.

On ERROR: {"ok": false, "error": "CODE", "message": "..."} — correct and retry:
- "no_start_time": missing day. Retry with a concrete YYYY-MM-DD date.
- "invalid_slot_target_date": date missformatted. Retry with a valid YYYY-MM-DD date.
- "no_availability_in_window": no free slots. Check the next available day and offer its closest slots.
- "upstream_unavailable": calendar down. Say you'll retry shortly, then retry.

slot_target_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the day the caller wants a slot for.
